name: Owyhee River (Lower)
blurb: Spring-only desert canyon in Oregon's far southeast corner. Hot springs, big walls, and a short boating window.

sections.notes: Usually floatable only March–May. A free BLM self-issue river permit is required. Scout Montgomery Rapid. Birch Creek is four-wheel-drive access; the road may close when soils are saturated.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency launch record and satellite imagery agree on this riverside access facility. The marker is an approximate facility location, not a surveyed landing edge.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Rome. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: The agency point identifies the BLM historic ranch hand-carry launch area. Remote shuttle: check Birch Creek Road conditions with BLM; do not attempt the road in wet conditions.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Birch Creek. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

mapAuditNote: Agency source and satellite facility review completed 2026-10-29. Only sections with two documented access sites and a separate section approval are shown; approximate markers do not establish an exact landing or river path.
